title: Ebola in Congo: 2nd Deadliest Outbreak Ever, 11,793 Cases and 5,779 Deaths
description_html:
Congo's Ebola outbreak is now the second largest and second deadliest on record, with 11,793 confirmed cases and 5,779 deaths, according to government data. The World Health Organization declared a global health emergency in August. We explain why this Bundibugyo strain is so hard to stop, why there is no vaccine or treatment made specifically for it, how it affects the US, Europe, Africa, Asia, the Gulf and India, what you should do, and our honest take.
